# Canonical replay-test signatures.
#
# Format: one entry per line — `<label>=<base58_signature>`. Empty lines
# and lines starting with `#` are ignored. The label is a free-form tag
# the live test uses to identify the case in failure messages.
#
# The live test (live_replay_canonical_sigs) is gated on
# REPLAY_LIVE_TESTS=1 + HELIUS_API_KEY and runs each non-PLACEHOLDER
# entry below. Replace the placeholders with real recent signatures
# before enabling.
#
# Order matters — first must work, second must work, third is the gate:
#   1. SOL transfer (SystemProgram only) — simplest case.
#   2. SPL Token transfer — small, deterministic.
#   3. Jupiter v6 swap — the real go/no-go gate (LUT-heavy, multi-CPI).

sol_transfer=PLACEHOLDER_SOL_TRANSFER_SIG
spl_token_transfer=PLACEHOLDER_SPL_TOKEN_TRANSFER_SIG
jupiter_v6_swap=PLACEHOLDER_JUPITER_V6_SWAP_SIG
